english.title: Fail to display goods vehicle operators disc

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: GOODS VEHICLES LICENSING OF OPERATORS REGULATIONS 1995
GOODS VEHICLES LICENSING OF OPERATORS ACT 1995

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the holder of an operator's licence at a time when a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), was specified in the licence, failed to cause a disc appropriate to the vehicle to be fixed to it in a waterproof container on the nearside

(A)_[and near to the lower edge of the front windscreen with the licence details facing forwards]_
(B)_[or front of the vehicle in a conspicuous position]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 23(3) and 32 of the Goods Vehicles (Licensing of Operators) Regulations 1995 and section 57(9) of the Goods Vehicles (Licensing of Operators) Act 1995.

english.notes:
(i) 'Front of the vehicle in a conspicuous position' refers to a vehicle not fitted with a front windscreen.
(ii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
english.standardstatementoffacts:
At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant, who was the holder of an operator's licence in which **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) was specified, failed to cause the appropriate disc to be fixed to the nearside

(A)_[of the windscreen on the vehicle.]_
(B)_[or front of the vehicle in a clearly visible position.]_
